name: Hachiyama Saisei
source: Fortune had never favored him as a child. He rose by scraping through the dirt, swallowing filth as he went. He trusts no one and is driven by an overpowering thirst for wealth and power. To acquire Rei's family enterprise - the Sakuragaoka Group - he used threats and money to bring the chairman of the academy under his control, becoming Special Advisor (acting chairman).
